review_description: Apple solar was a pleasure to deal with and they turned up when they said they would.  I'm very happy with my system and I have recommended them to several of my friends.  You can't beat them for value for money and great service.

They came for quote when arranged, organised install quickly (so beat the 1 July price changes) and supplied warrantys and paperwork soon after. Its pretty hard to know whether the systems and installation is great or otherwise at this early stage BUT the guys certainly seemed to know what they were doing and the meter now runs backwards so thats a good start!
Sales person and owner Ian was really informative and very helpful. Everyone we dealt with was great.
A great, no nonsense approach, very nice salesman, prompt service and ... great value for money!!!System is not yet connected to the grid.

Company contacted me as advised within the time frame. Electrician attended when stated and when there was a delay the next day he telephoned me and advised the reason for the delay.  Attended when stated and completed the job in a professional manner.

The rep was very efficient with his response to my requests. He explained and informed me of all aspects of installation procedures. What he said he would do, he did. Two out of three companies replied to me.Very pleased with the results!
In an industry where there is so much confusion on different products,size,quality&price!!,I was extremely happy with the service provided by Apple Solar and would recommend them to anyone.

Small issue with subcontract installer. He did not have everything with him to finish off on first trip, but was quickly rectified. Up and running 5 weeks after quote, not bad considering problems everywhere with floods etc.
now a wait for the digital meter because of the flood
We had to wait a while because of wet weather here in Queensland,but when they moved it was all great.!!
Ian from Applesolar responded quickly & professionally.Gave me good service by making a committment and deliverying on his promise.
